subject: general
question: 7 orange trees, 28 apple trees and 42 mangoes trees have to be planted in rows such that each row contains the same number of trees of one variety only. Minimum number of rows in which the trees may be planted is:
solution:
**Given:**

Trees(Orange) = O = 7

Trees(Apple) = A = 28

Trees(Mangoes) = M = 42

**Concept used:**

HCF (Highest Common Factor)

It is the product of the smallest power of each common prime factor in the numbers.

**Calculation:**

HCF(7,28, 42) = 7

This means, in one row, 7 same trees can be planted.

Now, total trees = 7 + 28 + 42 = 77

Minimum number of rows = (77)/(7) = 11 

**This means a minimum of 11 rows are needed to plant the same trees in a row.**
